name: Quote
purpose: One more customer quote in a testimonials section. If the quote is copied from a review someone left you online, use the linked variant and paste the link to it — a reader can then click through and check it on the listing itself.

variants.label: Same, but linked to the review it came from

inputs.label: What the customer said
inputs.example: They showed up on time, finished early, and left the site spotless. We could not be happier.

inputs.label: Who said it (name, or name and neighbourhood)
Link to the review
inputs.hint: paste the review's own https:// address; on Google, the Share button on the review gives you a short one
